column1: # The reviewed run spec (§2.7, round 17's AG2): each run's expectations, which the compare takes from here and never from
# a run's launch manifest. run <TAB> group <TAB> <process kind> <TAB> <n>: at least n processes of that kind with pairs.
# run <TAB> launch <TAB> <launch kind> <TAB> <n>: at least n launch rows of that kind (a gui row must also leave pairs).
# run <TAB> required <TAB> <function key> <TAB> <role>: a required pair (§2.7's table). run <TAB> advisory <TAB> <compiler>:
# on that compiler only the pair checks (PAIR-OUTSIDE-TABLE, MISSING-REQUIRED-PAIR) are reported and not gating; launch,
# dump, seal, malformed-input and unexpected-process failures still gate (r21, AJ3). A row may end with a compiler (0.15
# or 0.17) and then applies only to it. r19 (round 18's AH2): a function key is the file and the bare symbol name, at
# 31796f5d0; round 18's L3: the soak's pairs; r20 (round 19's L8): those pairs are required on 0.17.1; on 0.15.2 the
# soak's pair checks are advisory (§19.2), and its launch, dump and seal still gate.
